course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice conditional decision-making with om...skulle in a realistic choice.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Choosing between two plans when time, weather, or energy affects the decision.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Making a flexible decision based on conditions and preferences.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik choose between staying in, going out, or meeting friends depending on practical conditions.

main_focus.name: conditional decision-making with om...skulle
main_focus.description: Use conditional structures to connect possible conditions with decisions.
model_examples: Om vädret blev bättre, skulle vi kunna gå ut.
Om vi var för trötta, skulle vi stanna hemma.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use om...skulle naturally 2-3 times while deciding between options.

avoid_grammar: too many conditions in one sentence

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use flexible planning chunks that recycle earlier conditional language.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks what they should do later.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare two options and explain which conditions would affect the decision.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose a flexible plan or a clear backup.

target_complexity.repetition: review conditional and preference structures without adding new grammar

focus: what final or backup plan is agreed

sentence_focus: one sentence with det beror på
one sentence with om plus skulle
one sentence combining a condition, preference, and final plan
